text:
Ellen: Quick heads-up on PR #4701 - preview builds (Netlify & Vercel) are green but linkcheck job failed due to an external URL 502: https://vendor.example.com/sdk/docs -> HTTP 502.
Sam: Oof, linkcheck is strict. Which step failed? paste from CI: 
ci output: LINKCHECK ERROR: external link https://vendor.example.com/sdk/docs returned status 502
Ellen: That URL is in the migration guide example. It used to be stable but vendor is having partial outage. I can change it to our cached copy or point to the vendor's support page.
Vik: For unblock, we can: 1) swap to an internal snapshot URL (docs-hosted) in the PR, 2) add a temporary linkcheck exception comment in CI config for this PR only, or 3) wait until vendor fixes it. The merge window is at 22:00 UTC so waiting is risky.
Sam: I prefer 1) replace with our archived copy (we have `https://docs.redwood.ai/refs/vendor-sdk-v1.4.2`) and leave a comment to restore later. Add label `docs/linkcheck-external` and open `docs#245` to track reverting once vendor stabilizes.
ci-bot: linkcheck job failed (exit code 2) in build #1024. Non-linkcheck jobs: mkdocs build OK, lint OK, unit tests OK.
Ellen: I'll update the PR to use the archived URL and push a patch. Repro locally: 
```bash
pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material mkdocs-linkcheck
mkdocs build
mkdocs link-check --skip-external=false
```
Vik: Note for release coordination: if you plan to merge during the 22:00 UTC window, coordinate with release team to avoid triggering staging e2e.
release-coordinator: Please do not merge between 21:50-22:10 UTC; we have a short freeze for release activities.
Sam: Plan: Ellen patches link, adds `docs/linkcheck-external` label, we run linkcheck again, Vik does a quick content skim, then manual merge after CI green and outside the freeze. Create follow-up `docs#245` assigned to Ellen.
Ellen: Patch pushed, running CI. Will ping when green.
Sam: Thanks — once green I can approve.
Ellen: CI green now, linkcheck passed with archived URL. Merging after 22:15 UTC to avoid the freeze.
